tasks.note: Left out as too loose a match: 'write copy' (the site says 'Turns one asset into channel-native formats.') and 'send email campaigns' (nurture campaigns are named, email is not).

can_execute.quote: Books qualified meetings into reps’ calendars.
can_execute.note: Agent card (Meeting Scheduler), confirmed on a second read; another card says 'Logs notes and fires follow-ups after each call.' The site also lists 'Human-in-the-loop approvals' as a feature.

multi_agent.quote: Each agent owns a step, hands off context, and executes end to end.
multi_agent.note: Confirmed on a second read. Hero of the same page: 'Orchestrate AI agents to run entire processes'.

integrations.note: First 25 names of the homepage 'Connect to 1,000+ apps' list, in page order; the rest are in 'overflow'. The /integrations directory says 'Showing 48 of 2,728 integrations' and is alphabetical, so it was not used for this list.

pricing.note: https://relevanceai.com/pricing lists a single Enterprise plan with no price and a 'Talk to sales' button; no free plan or trial wording on the pages read (the homepage button says 'Try it out').

hq_location.note: No address or headquarters line. The terms page says 'OnSearch Pty Ltd, an Australian business with ABN 33 637 909 409 trading as Relevance AI' and 'These Terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia.', which states a country of business but not a headquarters.

notes: The integrations directory page is very large (about 344,000 characters of text) and shows a partial list, so a plain fetcher may get a truncated or paginated list.
